features.name: Cloghill
features.fullDescription: T-plan. Original part 2-storey 2-window with skew-putts, formerly dated I.M. 1771; addition at right angles with fanlight doorpiece c.1790, low kitchen wing perhaps a little later. Coped chimneys. Plain interior substantially unaltered

features.name: Fairley
features.fullDescription: Mansion. Remaining part built c. 1800 and extended later. Two storeys and garrets. Harled. Slated roof. Bow-front. Round stair-tower with hood-moulding over door and conical roof. Victorian extension in granite with bay-windows.
